# Northwest Siding

> Northwest Siding Contractors of Eugene, Inc. is the Exclusive Preferred Remodeler of James Hardie siding products for Eugene-Springfield, Oregon. More than 25 years in business and over 2,000 homes completed. Oregon CCB #136733. Licensed, bonded and insured. GuildQuality Master Award winner.

## Services
- Fiber cement siding: James Hardie HardiePlank, HardieShingle and HardiePanel, installed to factory specification with the manufacturer warranty.
- Cedar and wood siding: clear beveled lap cedar, cedar shingles and Douglas fir panel.
- Replacement windows: Milgard Tuscany, Montecito and Style Line series.
- Seamless gutters: custom-fabricated on site in steel and aluminum.
- Painting and trim.

## Service area
Eugene, Springfield, Albany, Roseburg and Creswell, Oregon.
